'''Pendo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] following the [[New Sith Wars]] and the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

==Biography==
Identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Pendo was serving the Order and the Republic as a Knight by [[980 BBY]]. An agent of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]], Pendo was active in the Council's hunt for [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifacts]] left over from the [[New Sith Wars]]. Under the leadership of [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker]] [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]], the agents of the Council were stationed out of the Temple's [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] from which they went out across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in an attempt to purge all memory of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from the collective memory of the galactic community.<ref name="DoE" />

When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of [[Doan]] arrived at the Temple to meet with Councilor [[Obba]], Pendo and fellow Knights [[Ma'ya]] and [[Winnoa]] met the Doan delegation on the landing platform at the base of the tower. Escorting their guests to the greenhouse-like [[Obba's quarters|living quarters]] of the esteemed [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Master, the three Knights waited in [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] outside of the chambers while the brief conference took place. When the meeting concluded, Master Obba emerged and dismissed the Jedi, allowing them to return to their duties higher in the tower.<ref name="DoE" />
